summary: Choose USD or EUR as the store's pricing currency, with existing prices converted and every screen, label and printout following it; both currencies on the exchange card.
highlights: Pricing currency (USD or EUR) in CRM options; USD stays the default.
Switching converts product and service prices at your USD/EUR rates; LYD prices stay the same.
Invoices and purchase invoices keep the currency they were made in.
Fields, tables, cards, printouts and the opening-stock workbook follow the chosen currency, in English and Arabic.
The exchange card shows USD and EUR: store, official and market rates, and how fresh each is.
Celery no longer needs internet access: exchange rates come through the Composer 1.6.0 egress relay.
